title: DevDocker Configuration
description: Configuration file for DevDocker tasks. Place devdocker.json in any project directory to define Docker-based development tasks.

type.description: Task type: 'exec' runs a command and exits, 'shell' opens an interactive terminal

image.description: Docker image name (subdirectory name under the docker/ directory)

command.description: Command to execute in the container (required for exec tasks)

description.description: Task description shown in the UI

network_mode.description: Docker network mode. Overrides the default from settings.

volumes.description: Volume mounts. Supports {project_root} and {workspaceFolder} placeholders. Overrides the default from settings.

working_dir.description: Container working directory. Overrides the default from settings.

run_as_user.description: Run as current user (uid:gid). Overrides the default from settings.

env.description: Environment variables. ${VAR} references are resolved from host environment.

ports.description: Port mappings (only used when network_mode is not 'host')
